assessments.reason: SpecEvo archives failed/successful trials and allocates stronger navigation strategically; established Scout technical research question.
assessments.counterargument: Earlier synthetic tests did not reproduce source results or establish practical benefit.
assessments.next_test: Review actual failed-research decision receipts without production model calls.

assessments.reason: Successive Scale Racing selects task evidence during agent harness evolution; its central variable is omitted by Scout vocabulary tagging.
assessments.counterargument: Reported benchmark gains may overfit; larger task pools and efficient validation do not establish safety or transfer to GhostMesh.
assessments.next_test: Compare held-out source selection on fixed nonprivileged GhostMesh research fixtures against simple equal-budget task sampling.

assessments.reason: Infrastructure scaling for agent-generated Git activity overlaps with GhostMesh's concurrent worker coordination.
assessments.counterargument: GitHub-scale infrastructure problems may have little direct relevance to a single-owner GhostMesh mesh.
assessments.next_test: Read primary engineering techniques and list actual bottlenecks observed in GhostMesh first.

assessments.reason: Agent-facing web commerce tooling may have implications for public Web agent interfaces.
assessments.counterargument: Commercial storefront tooling is not automatically applicable to private Scout ingestion or GhostMesh authorization.
assessments.next_test: Map public interface semantics and real GhostMesh web capability gap before prioritizing.

assessments.reason: Neutral agent-skill packaging may reduce interoperability friction across runtimes.
assessments.counterargument: Skills format does not convey trust, permission or credentials.
assessments.next_test: Offline skill schema compatibility test with malicious/invalid fixtures.

assessments.reason: Vocabulary specialization might reduce cost for repetitive local outputs.
assessments.counterargument: Reported savings are narrow and tokenizer retraining may hurt accuracy or portability.
assessments.next_test: Measure representative existing corpus fragmentation, quality and serving cost first.
